proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: MCP/agentic actions are not decision-grade until identity, authority, duplicate execution, partial failure, rollback/compensation and audit are proven.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Unauthorized actions are blocked; duplicates are safe; partial state is detected; required confirmations occur; recovery and audit are complete.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Run the proposed topology at peak concurrent agents/interactions/queues, digital concurrency, API calls, transfers, recordings and failover conditions.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Load metrics, API responses, queue/routing traces, WEM/reporting results and architecture signoff.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Undocumented limit, partitioning or throttling changes the buyer operating model or surge target cannot be met.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: What is the largest topology comparable to ours that has been load-tested under peak failure conditions, not just deployed at steady state?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Buyer peak forecast, proposed regions/control planes, representative integrations and traffic generator.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Current public material supports enterprise scale but does not provide a complete buyer-relevant hard limits matrix.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: No unacceptable queueing, dropped/misrouted interactions, API throttling or reporting/WEM degradation; headroom and scale thresholds are documented.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Create two client programs with shared agents; isolate routing, recordings, WEM/QM, knowledge, AI, integrations, admins, reporting and usage; misconfigure one client.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Access tests, recordings, reports, usage exports, incident logs and client-specific admin views.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Cross-client exposure, policy bleed, unusable pooled-agent workflow, shared blast radius or inability to allocate cost.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Can one shared agent serve two clients without exposing data, quality policy, AI context, recordings or usage between them?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Two representative client policies/data sets, shared agent pool, client-specific integrations/knowledge and usage tags.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Large BPO references prove market relevance but do not prove every current Infinity multi-client isolation, pooled-agent and usage-attribution requirement.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: No cross-client data/policy leakage; agent switching works; reporting/WEM/AI are client-correct; failure remains contained; usage can be attributed.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Design the same buyer requirement as a cloud-only Infinity deployment and compare required control planes, services, implementation work, admin roles and three-year TCO with a simpler class peer.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Architecture comparison, SOW, admin RACI, TCO and proof burden.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Buyer gains no material differentiated value from migration/hybrid architecture but still inherits higher implementation/change complexity.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: For customers with no Avaya installed base, what implementation and Day-2 complexity disappears compared with a typical hybrid modernization?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Greenfield requirements with no retained Avaya assets and two equivalent reference architectures.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Avaya's migration/hybrid strengths can become unnecessary complexity for a greenfield simplicity-first buyer.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Infinity delivers material buyer value that justifies the extra architecture/services burden; or can be deployed without that burden.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Recreate top production routing scenarios including skills, priority/SLA, digital, transfer, overflow, expected-wait logic, after-hours and external workflow actions.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Routing traces, workflow config, agent/supervisor screens and failure outcomes.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Unsupported routing state, context loss, hidden custom-code dependency or incorrect failure behavior.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which routing policies require code, professional services or retained Elite rather than standard Infinity configuration?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Buyer routing decision table and representative CRM/context data.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Routing and workflow breadth must be proven against buyer policies rather than inferred from platform positioning.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Every scenario produces correct assignment, context, state and fallback with observable decision evidence.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Run forecasting/scheduling/QA/recording/analytics for representative queues and test one upgrade/integration failure across Infinity and the chosen WEM path.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Forecast/schedule, scorecards, recording, support RACI, SLA and failure logs.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Capability exists but requires an unacceptable separate control plane/support model or data/integration behavior fails buyer needs.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which WEM functions are supported directly by Avaya versus Verint, and who owns the incident when data between them is wrong?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Representative historical workload, quality rubric, queue mappings and chosen Verint/BYO architecture.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: WEM capability is real, but product/bundle/tenant/support boundaries with Verint and BYO WEM must match the buyer operating model.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: WFM/QM workflows meet requirements; data is timely; support owner is clear; upgrade/failure recovery works; bundle/SLA is explicit.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Configure the required outbound modes, pacing, retries, DNC/time-zone rules, campaign controls and agentless use case in the contracted environment.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Product entitlement, release/GA evidence, campaign logs, compliance settings and quote.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Required mode is roadmap/vendor-stated only, requires another product or cannot meet compliance/scale.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which outbound modes are GA in our exact Infinity bundle today, and which require legacy/partner components?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Buyer campaign list, compliance rules, geographies and required modes.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Preview Outbound is GA, while broader predictive/progressive/agentless claims require exact current product/maturity/compliance proof.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Every required mode is contractually/currently supported, compliant and operational at buyer scale with acceptable pacing and reporting.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Map recordings, transcripts, metadata, analytics, WEM, AI prompts/outputs, backups, logs and support access by region/provider.

proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Any mandatory data class/process/support path violates required jurisdiction or remains ambiguous.

proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: All mandatory data classes and access paths meet location/jurisdiction policy contractually and technically.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Export a representative historical data set plus configuration/workflow artifacts and document number/carrier, WEM, AI and CRM migration steps.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Change routing, workflow, integration, WEM config and an AI/tool policy through the proposed release process; then perform rollback/recovery.

proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: A critical change must be edited directly in production without sufficient validation, audit or rollback.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Model base, peak and high-automation years for transcription, analytics API, storage, VA/agentic interactions, partner models and human fallback.

proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Material driver is unpriced/uncontrollable or automation economics fail after fallback/repair/third-party costs.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which AI or API meter has produced the largest invoice variance in comparable deployments?
